points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight named workspace packages pass a fresh structural validator. Generated report assets are committed; raw output and its manifest are workspace evidence, not committed submission data.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Fresh read-only examiner validate_outputs.py passes all eight named canonical workspace output directories; it is a structural check and does not detect the verified field-rendering defect or prove physical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Eight metadata packages report completion and Re200 shows raw periodic forces; M200 laminar final200 Cd0.07486→0.04455 despite 30-row flat criterion, so sustained steady convergence is uncertain even though reported residual target was reached.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.037 and Re200 mean Cd1.15175/St0.16333 are plausible; M200 laminar Cd0.04455 is less than inviscid Cd0.09201 and its 200-row drift is large. No inference of actual physical failure solely from this comparison.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All eight committed Mach images reproduce from the source field but misassign many cell values to triangles (see DQ8 and ledger); shared renderer affects other cell contours, and Re200 late drag is unreadable. Residual, force and surface plots are delivered.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Delivered compiled 48-page report contains methods, outputs and reported rank discrepancy; all eight full Mach plots demonstrably misassign source cell values, and Re200 force plot hides late drag. Original data exist and script error is not evidence of invented histories.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Figure manifest identifies source fields, and direct reproduction identifies a systematic wrong-cell rendering; exact historical solver binaries are unbound.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
